goal: Root and nested public-subagent resumes share one resume-compatibility policy in the existing invocation-policy module. Omitting any of the five fixed settings (inherit_context, isolated, pair, profile, system_prompt) reuses the stored choice, including a stored true for inherit_context and isolated. A setting given explicitly with the same value is accepted. A setting given explicitly with a different value is rejected before resume, and the stored choices stay unchanged. Blank system_prompt counts as omitted. run_in_background can change on each call. Ownership checks and new-session defaults stay as they are. Documentation and model-visible guidance describe the corrected behavior.
